## 1. Complete Vetted Directory of 15 Pickleball Courts in Thailand (5 Cities)

### Bangkok (Capital Hub - Dedicated Indoor & Covered Complexes)
1. **Arise Pickleball (Udom Suk, Eastern Sukhumvit)**
   - Transit: Take BTS Skytrain (Sukhumvit Line) to Udom Suk Station, then a 5-to-10-minute taxi or Grab (roughly 30 to 40 minutes total by Grab from central Sukhumvit / Asok; 150 to 250 THB each way).
   - Setup: Multi-court covered/indoor dedicated pickleball complex co-founded by Siree and Sang Chanyaputhipong. High roof clearance, tournament-grade acrylic surfaces, and strong airflow. Host venue for The Pickleball Passport Bangkok Clinic Week (Mon Nov 2 & Wed Nov 4, 2026) and flagship Bangkok sessions.
2. **Sterling Sport & Wellness (Bangkok)**
   - Setup: Upscale multi-sport and wellness facility with dedicated indoor/covered pickleball courts, clean locker rooms, and post-session recovery appeal.
3. **Papaya Pickleball Club (Bangkok)**
   - Setup: Community-focused Bangkok pickleball venue known for friendly open-play rotations, coaching drills, and social atmosphere. Host venue for The Pickleball Passport Bangkok Clinic Week (Tue Nov 3 & Thu Nov 5, 2026).

### Hua Hin (Royal Gulf Coast - 3 Hours South of Bangkok by Private Car/Van)
4. **Sports Life Hua Hin** - Covered multi-court community hub with regular morning and late-afternoon rotational play.
5. **T-Rex Sports Club (Hua Hin)** - Popular local and expat club hosting organized open play and skill-grouped sessions.
6. **Bluport (Hua Hin)** - Central Hua Hin venue at Bluport, near dining, shopping, and beach resorts.

### Pattaya (Eastern Seaboard - 90 Minutes from Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport BKK)
7. **88 Pickleball (Pattaya)** - Dedicated Pattaya venue running organized open play and group sessions.
8. **Skyline (Pattaya)** - Popular court setup drawing both local residents and visiting players.
9. **Sunshine (Pattaya)** - Welcoming coastal club with regular morning and evening play windows.

### Chiang Mai (Northern Cultural & Mountain Hub - 75-Minute Flight from Bangkok)
10. **BokBok Pickleball Chiang Mai** - Dedicated covered courts with one of the friendliest international and local player communities in Northern Thailand.
11. **All-Time Pickleball Chiang Mai** - High-roof covered courts hosting structured open play, round robins, and private court blocks.
12. **Rally House Chiang Mai** - Boutique Chiang Mai court hub ideal for morning clinics and social games.

### Phuket (Andaman Island Resort Hub)
13. **Raccoon Pickleball Club (Phuket)** - Established Phuket pickleball club hosting visiting players and organized games.
14. **Sharkbites (Phuket)** - Island venue with social and competitive play windows.
15. **Pickleball Phuket** - Local community hub; message ahead to confirm weekly session times.

---

## 2. 2026 Thailand Pickleball Price & Cost Benchmarks (33 THB = $1 USD)
- Open Play Drop-In Session (2 to 3 hours): 150 to 350 THB ($4.50 to $11 USD) per person
- Private Covered / Indoor Court Rental (per court, per hour): 400 to 900 THB ($12 to $27 USD)
- BTS Skytrain / MRT Ride + Short Grab to Bangkok Courts: 120 to 280 THB ($3.50 to $8.50 USD) one way
- Private Car / Luxury Van Transfer (Bangkok to Hua Hin or Pattaya): 2,200 to 3,500 THB ($67 to $106 USD) per vehicle
- Round-Trip Domestic Flight (Bangkok to Chiang Mai or Phuket with bag): 2,800 to 5,200 THB ($85 to $158 USD)
- 90-Minute Traditional Thai Sports Massage: 400 to 900 THB ($12 to $27 USD)

---

## 3. Seasonal Calendar & Daily Heat Play Windows
- **Best Daily Play Windows Year-Round:** 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Protect 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM for lunch, hotel pool recovery, sightseeing, and Thai massage unless playing inside an indoor air-conditioned or dedicated roofed venue.
- **Cool & Dry Season (November to February):** Peak overall season nationwide. Best pairings: Bangkok + Chiang Mai (Jan) or Bangkok + Hua Hin (Feb).
- **Hot Season (March to May):** Peak afternoon temperatures. Northern Thailand (Chiang Mai) experiences agricultural smoky season from late February through mid-April; travelers in March and April pivot to Bangkok indoor courts paired with Phuket (March) or Pattaya / Hua Hin (April Songkran).
- **Green / Monsoon Season (June to October):** Sunny/cloudy mornings with predictable 45-to-60-minute late-afternoon showers. Play morning sessions or book covered/indoor venues in Bangkok and Hua Hin.

---

## 4. Official Programs & Dates (2026-2027)
1. **Bangkok Pickleball Clinic Week with Coach Travis Rhea (November 1 to 5, 2026)**
   - Venues: Arise Pickleball (Mon Nov 2 & Wed Nov 4, 11am to 2pm) Papaya Pickleball Club (Tue Nov 3, 11am to 2pm), and Pick A Court (Thu Nov 5, 11am to 2pm) in Bangkok; Welcome dinner Sun Nov 1.
   - Coaching Team: Coach Travis Rhea (Mind Your Pickle) on mental performance, plus Jaron Shoptaugh and Ryan Magill on court.
   - Cohort Size: Maximum 16 players across 4 courts (with live Thai translation and Thai slides in mindset sessions).
   - Pricing: $169 USD Two-Day Pass (2 sessions) | $299 USD Full Clinic Week (4 sessions).
   - URLs: https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/clinics | https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/reserve
2. **2027 9-Day / 8-Night Multi-City Thailand Trips ($5,500)**

   - **February 18 to 26, 2027 (Bangkok + Hua Hin):** https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips/bangkok-hua-hin/february-18-2027

3. **Private Club & Coach Destination Retreats (B2B)**
   - Custom 16-player / 4-court private cohorts for US, UK, Australian, and APAC pickleball clubs and racquet directors, coordinated by our dedicated on-the-ground team in Bangkok and local Thai destination management company (DMC) partners.
